summary: Preflight pinned analyzer environments and separate explicit tool updates

delivery.outcome: Deliver read-only pinned tool/sumr preflight and an explicit separate environment update command whose success stamp is written only after isolated environment verification, exact installation, postflight and lock persistence; protected independent review and merge.
nonGoals: No automatic installation during scans or planning
No adoption, CI/hook changes or external execution/synchronization
No writes to preserved peer analyzer_snapshot ticket/worktree

architecture.decision: Reuse evidence contract pins. Inspect metadata through an isolated interpreter without importing project/analyzer modules. Keep update as a separate explicit command with native file locking, bounded process groups, exact version arguments and atomic success receipts. Preserve unknown paths and prior successful stamps on failure.
interfaceChanges: python -m wellman.analysis_environment preflight --python PYTHON; explicit update --environment DIR
architecture.rollback: Protected revert of this additive slice.

validation.evidence: Read-only version/sumr checks, isolated exact-pin updates, failure-preserving stamps and unknown/symlink storage protection.
Full tests and accepted-base managed gate pass; independent protected exact-head approval and merge.
